mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly growth rate in real GDP (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity, which increases corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when GDPC1 quarterly growth rate is positive, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6.0% signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when UNRATE is below 6.0%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 5.5%) combined with rising residential sales (RSAFS above 3-month moving average) signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when both UNRATE < 5.5% and RSAFS > 3-month moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% and sustained for 3 months), higher interest rates compress equity valuations and increase borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC remains above -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below the 3-month moving average signals a contraction in manufacturing and services, reducing corporate output and profits, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when INDPRO < 3-month moving average, or the Rank IC remains above -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 3% and UNRATE < 5.0%), the economy is overheating, leading to potential Fed tightening and reduced risk appetite, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when GDPC1 growth > 3% and UNRATE < 5.0%, or the Rank IC remains above -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the annual inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals rising inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to tighten policy, which compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when CPIAUCSL annual growth > 3.0%, or the Rank IC remains above -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) below 1000.0 (thousands of units) signals a cooling housing market, which reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) in periods when HOUST < 1000.0, or the Rank IC remains above -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
